title: Trochleary

inlines.v: TROCH'LEARY, adjective [from Latin trochlea.] Pertaining to the trochlea; as the trochleary muscle, the superior oblique muscle of the eye; the trochleary nerve, the pathetic nerve, which goes to that muscle.
